name: Phantom Mold
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
description: A burst of pale gray spores sprays into the air.
disable: DC 18 Survival check to remove the mold without triggering the spores

offensiveAbilities.name: Spore Burst
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The moldy books are moved or the mold takes any damage;

Effect All creatures within 10 feet of the mold patch are exposed to phantom mold spores.

offensiveAbilities.name: Phantom Mold Spores
offensiveAbilities.description:
Any penalties to Perception from this poison persist for 1 hour after the poison's duration ends (this effect can be removed before then by any effect that neutralizes poison);

Saving Throw DC 18 Fortitude save;

Maximum Duration 4 rounds;

Stage 1 1d6 poison damage;

Stage 2 1d6 poison damage, and the victim takes a -1 status penalty on visual Perception checks as strange shadows and flittering movement appear in their peripheral vision;

Stage 3 as stage 2, but a -2 status penalty.
